user.title: Add Pixelix device
user.description: Enter the host name or IP address and the web login of the device. Pixelix devices in the network are normally found automatically.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the Pixelix device.
data_description.port: Port of the web server of the device.
data_description.username: Website login user, which is set in the settings of the device.
data_description.password: Website login password, which is set in the settings of the device.

discovery_confirm.title: Add Pixelix device
discovery_confirm.description: {name} was found at {host}. Enter its web login.

data_description.username: Website login user, which is set in the settings of the device.
data_description.password: Website login password, which is set in the settings of the device.

reauth_confirm.title: Update web login
reauth_confirm.description: {name} ({host}) rejected the web login. Enter the current web login of the device.

data_description.username: Website login user, which is set in the settings of the device.
data_description.password: Website login password, which is set in the settings of the device.

error.unexpected_response: The device answered unexpectedly. Is it a Pixelix device with a compatible firmware?

abort.wrong_device: Another device with a different host name answers at this address. If the host name was changed, remove the device and add it again.
